## EcclesiaOS v1.0.66

### Administrator-controlled public website themes

- Added a Website Studio setting that lets administrators allow or disable visitor theme changes.
- When visitor theme changes are disabled, the public website consistently enforces the administrator-selected light or dark appearance.
- Previously saved visitor theme preferences are ignored while the website theme is locked.
- Applied the theme policy consistently across the homepage, event pages, and sermon pages.
- Improved dark mode so event cards, event side panels, mobile navigation, and mobile menu controls no longer retain white backgrounds.
- Corrected remaining public button hover styling in light mode.

### Compatibility

- Existing websites continue to allow visitor theme changes by default.
- No database migration is required; the setting is stored with the existing website configuration.

### Verification

- The Website Studio feature suite passes with 13 tests and 400 assertions.
- The release is verified with the complete PHP test suite, Composer validation, production frontend build, and Git whitespace checks.
